title: Three lives
summary: A star hitting the ground costs a life. No lives left: an end screen.
done: You saw lives, the “if” test and the end screen.

hello.text: In level 3, you have 3 lives. Let 3 stars fall in the preview to see the end screen.

start.text: At the start, the **lives** variable is 3.

miss.text: A star touches the bottom: one life less, we show it, then we check whether the game is lost.

check.text: The [if] block asks a question: “lives ≤ 0?”. Only if it is true do we stop the rain, delete the clones and open the End screen.

end.text: The **End** screen has its own blocks: pick it here to see them, then come back to Game.

slow.text: Start **slow motion**: blocks will light up one by one while the game runs.

watch.text: Look: [change lives by -1] lights up when a star hits the ground. Let one fall!
watch.hint: Wait a little, or click “Restart” in the preview.

fast.text: Well spotted! Stop slow motion to play at normal speed again.

five.hint: It is at the start, in [set lives to 3].

hard.text: Hard mode: lose 2 lives per missed star.
hard.hint: Change the -1 in “when Star touches the bottom edge”.

message.text: Show a short message when the game is lost.
message.hint: The block is in the Interface category.
